staticFindings.completeComponentPredicate: The unchanged comparator JSON-canonicalizes independent copies; component position, every descriptor field, array multiplicity and all non-descriptor component fields remain exact. staticFindings.import: The comparator import is lazy inside the new function, consistent with the existing archive verifier's lazy dependency. No new import-time project operation is added.
staticFindings.originalValidationOrder: Both observed producer identities and Git contexts, both bounded digest-authenticated original four-file archives, both complete raw reports and original descriptor references, source/config/workflow/scope/extraction bindings, result multiplicity/full-record hashes, installed review binding and retained raw digests are verified before the new cross-summary comparison.
staticFindings.originals: No input summary, original component array, raw report, ordered metadata, raw digest or returned actual summary is rewritten. The comparison copy is used only after the complete component predicate succeeds.
staticFindings.preservedReleaseControls: All source/archive/reference/raw/result/independent-review/service/native/API/publisher/binder policies and workflows outside the stated comparison change are byte-identical to the parent.
staticFindings.remainingSummary: The existing semanticSummary removes only producer, reviewSource, reviewTree, reviewEvidence and reviewedProducer. All required semantic fields and any additional outer fields remain in the strict comparison. No remaining-field allowlist or new omission is introduced.
